summary: Iteration 6 (YouTube-Music search suggestions, Spotify-style Jam listen-together with QR + WebSocket sync, Apple-Music-style lyrics incl. auto-timed Hinglish, playback-progress split context) FULLY VERIFIED. Backend: 10/10 pytest (test_iteration6.py) — GET /api/search/suggest?q=arij returns 200 with suggestions incl. 'Arijit Singh' and 8 entities of types song/artist/album; song entities include a 'track' object with id/title/artist/artwork. q=kesar returns 'Kesariya' in entity titles. Short q ('a') → 200, missing q → 422. /api/lyrics for 6 trending Hindi tracks → all 200 with keys synced/plain/instrumental/source; 6/6 had synced from lrclib (spec required >=3/6). 'Kesariya' via /api/tracks/search + /api/lyrics returned synced (source lrclib). Jam REST: POST /api/jam → 200 with 6-char code matching [A-Z0-9], host_device, members[], server_time. GET back OK. GET /api/jam/NOPE00 → 404. GET /api/jam/time → server_time. DELETE with wrong device_id → 403; with host device → {ended:true}; then GET → 404. WebSocket via ws://localhost:8001/api/jam/ws/{code}: host hello + guest hello → host receives members(2) → host sends state → guest gets state with at + server_time → guest sends control 'toggle' → host receives control with from_name='Guest' → guest sends add_track → host receives add_track → ping{123} → pong{client_time:123}. Host disconnect → guest receives {type:'ended'} and GET /api/jam/{code} → 404. Public WSS (wss://rhythm-glass-ui.preview.emergentagent.com/api/jam/ws/{code}) also connects and receives hello — ingress proxies WebSocket. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844): Search tab: typing 'arij' shows suggestion-list with 5 suggest-text-* rows + 3 suggest-entity-artist-* + 3 suggest-entity-song-* rows, 5 suggest-fill-* arrows; tapping suggest-fill-'Arijit Singh' fills the input with 'Arijit Singh'; tapping suggest-text-'Arijit Singh' shows 'Songs' header and results; search-clear reveals 'Recent searches' with recent-'Arijit Singh' and recent-remove-'Arijit Singh'; 8 trending suggestion-* chips; recent-clear empties the section. Player: player-jam pill visible with 'Jam' text. Lyrics: player-lyrics-btn opens lyrics-screen for 'Humnava Mere' with synced timing (active-lyric-line present, no red screen); the plain-only lyrics-approx pill branch is code-verified (lyrics.tsx:124-129) but not triggered because 20/20 tested trending Hindi tracks already returned synced from lrclib. Jam host: jam-screen with jam-name, jam-start, jam-code-input, jam-join; after jam-start → jam-code (6 chars, e.g. R4UAD8), QR svg rendered, jam-share, jam-leave, jam-copy-code (shows 'Code copied' toast), 1 jam-member-*, 'Listening · 1'. Second fresh browser context opening /jam?code=<CODE> auto-joins: guest sees 'Hosted by Host' (1 occurrence), 2 jam-member-* rows in both host and guest, 'Playing together' shown on guest. Guest jam-toggle sends control → host toast contains 'Guest' (2 hits). Guest jam-leave → host member count drops back to 1. Host 'End jam' → toast 'The jam has ended' and GET /api/jam/<code> → 404. Regression smoke: Home 23 track-row-*; track-more-* ⋯ sheet still exposes action-play-next / action-add-queue / action-start-radio / action-favorite / action-view-artist / action-download / action-create-playlist; queue-screen opens & queue-close works; home-settings opens settings-screen. Only pre-existing warning: HTMLAudio 'Failed to load because no supported source was found' from JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 on web + Chrome autoplay 'play() failed because the user didn't interact' (both expected). No React Native red screen. No deprecated Expo packages introduced.

integration_issues.issue: Chromium HTMLAudio still throws 'Failed to load because no supported source was found' for JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 on web; not blocking native.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /search/suggest (line 168-239): builds text suggestions from topquery + songs, entities from songs (with normalized 'track'), artists, albums, and reinserts topquery entities at the front. Dedupes text case-insensitively and skips echoing the query. Solid.

server.py /lyrics (line 444-520): four progressively-loose LRCLIB queries, prefers synced + closest duration via _pick_lrc, falls back to JioSaavn plain lyrics keyed by track_id (for Hinglish Bollywood). This is exactly the fix that lets Apple-Music-style auto-timing work on the frontend.

server.py Jam (line 794-923): in-memory JamRoom keyed by code (32-char alphabet excludes I/O/0/1 — no visual ambiguity). WS host authorization for state (line 899) prevents guests spoofing playback. Host disconnect broadcasts 'ended' and removes the room. One live room per host_device enforced on POST. All good.
server.py Jam WS URL uses the /api prefix so Kubernetes ingress correctly forwards to backend port 8001 — public WSS verified.
jam-context.tsx (281 lines) and jam.tsx (322 lines) sit within limits. lyrics.tsx (269 lines) is fine.
Note: jam_rooms is in-memory only — a backend restart drops all rooms. Acceptable for MVP but consider Redis/Mongo persistence for scale.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested surface (search suggestions incl. fill/text/entity + recents/trending, player-jam pill, lyrics-screen with synced timing + active-lyric-line, jam host create/copy/share/leave, guest deep-link auto-join via /jam?code=, guest control → host toast, member updates, host end → 404, regression smoke on ⋯ sheet / queue / settings)

seed_data_creation: None — all jam rooms are in-memory. Tests DELETE their own rooms via host device_id. Test devices used: hostdev, hostdev-ws, hostdev-ws2, hostdev-wss (all cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key iteration-6 testIDs: search-screen, search-input, search-clear, recent-<term>, recent-remove-<term>, recent-clear, suggestion-<label> (trending chip), suggestion-list, suggest-text-<text>, suggest-fill-<text>, suggest-entity-artist-<id>, suggest-entity-song-<id>, suggest-entity-album-<id>, suggest-search-for. Jam: jam-screen, jam-close, jam-name, jam-start, jam-code-input, jam-join, jam-code, jam-copy-code, jam-share, jam-leave, jam-member-<device>, jam-prev, jam-toggle, jam-next. Lyrics: lyrics-screen, lyrics-close, lyrics-approx (only when synced=null && plain present), active-lyric-line (current line only). Player: player-jam (was added in iter 6), player-lyrics-btn. Backend routes new in iter 6: GET /api/search/suggest?q=, GET /api/lyrics (extended track_id fallback), POST /api/jam, GET /api/jam/{code}, DELETE /api/jam/{code}?device_id=, GET /api/jam/time, WS /api/jam/ws/{code}?device_id=&name=. Public WSS (wss://<preview>/api/jam/ws/{code}) verified working through ingress. Jam rooms are in-memory (backend restart drops them). Trending Hindi (limit=6) currently returns 6/6 synced lyrics from lrclib — the auto-time plain-lyrics branch on the frontend is code-verified but not runtime-triggered on the current trending set (rare Hindi tracks may still hit it).
rca_of_issue: N/A — the user-reported 'not like Apple Music with Hinglish lyrics' bug is verified fixed: /api/lyrics now runs four progressive LRCLIB searches (line 486-491 in server.py) with _simplify_title stripping '(From "Movie")' etc., preferring synced + closest-duration matches, and falls back to JioSaavn's plain Hinglish lyrics keyed by track_id. Frontend auto-times plain lyrics into individual pressable lines with the lyrics-approx pill. 6/6 trending Hindi tracks now return synced (source lrclib).
